segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the basics before I send the order form: 42 user seats, the reporting add-on, and a July 15 go-live. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. It is 38 regular users and 4 managers, but yeah, 42 total. We need the first invoice to show the PO number, PO-44718, or finance will kick it back.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The order form will list 42 seats and the invoice reference will include PO-44718. For term, we have August 1, 2026 through July 31, 2027, annual billing, net 30. The total is $31,920 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the onboarding hours we talked about? The two admin sessions and one end-user training?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, so that's included as a separate line item at no additional charge: two 90-minute admin sessions and one 60-minute end-user training. I’ll put the dates as targeted the week of July 8, with exact times set on the kickoff call.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal asked about auto-renewal. We can do renewal language, but we need 60 days notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that’s already in the contract notes: either party can give non-renewal notice at least 60 days before the end of the term. No issue there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One more thing, our team in Denver needs access on day one, but the Austin group can come in later, probably August.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. We’ll start with the Denver users for launch and you can assign the remaining seats when Austin is ready. You’re not paying extra unless you go above 42.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it to me and copy our procurement inbox. If it matches what we covered, I can sign tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have the order form and service schedule by 3 p.m. today, copied to procurement, with the PO number, 60-day notice language, and July 15 go-live.
